author: massicomar
title: Prime or Not
summary:
Given the number, you are to answer the question: "Is it prime?"

Solutions to this problem can be submitted in C, C++, Pascal, Perl, Python, Ruby, Lisp, Hask, Ocaml, Prolog, Whitespace, Brainf**k and Intercal only.

Input

t – the number of test cases, then t test cases follows. [t ≤ 500]
Each line contains one integer: N [2 ≤ N ≤ 263-1]

Output

For each test case output string "YES" if given number is prime and "NO" otherwise.
explanation: √N ≈ 3e9 per test is too slow: deterministic Miller–Rabin with fixed bases.
